title: Marlene Dumas poster
slide_intent: Give the artwork room to attract attention while preserving identification, because an image-led invitation must still tell viewers what and where it is.
strategic_value: The enlarged pale face beside the black MoMA signature can combine an emotional encounter with immediate museum recognition.
demonstration: A large sideways portrait fills the lower-left field below an exhibition heading. A narrow right strip holds a programme listing, vertical MoMA logo and small institutional text.
practical_value: Compare a dominant artwork crop with the small information zones needed to identify the exhibition.

content_islands.name: Exhibition heading
content_islands.spec: Place dates, Marlene Dumas and Measuring Your Own Grave across the upper-left white band.

content_islands.name: Artwork field
content_islands.spec: Fill the large lower-left area with the pale sideways portrait, allowing the face to approach the edges.

content_islands.name: Signature strip
content_islands.spec: Stack magenta secondary programme text, oversized black vertical MoMA lettering and small institutional details down the right edge.

reference_purposes.Expression: The pale enlarged portrait contrasts with the heavy black vertical signature.
reference_purposes.Application: The poster combines exhibition identification, artwork and a separate programme listing.
